ops.title: Block unbounded searches over the CCI blob corpus before they create host IO pressure

ops.text: Prevent whole ~/.cc-inbox/blobs content traversal through the existing search guard, including supported home, variable and cd-relative spellings
Preserve exact blob-file and filename-scoped queries without adding corpus discovery or hot-path scans
Pass unchanged regression CI, merge, release, install locally and verify the exact installed predicate cases
